description: Credit note for a standard-rated purchase, correcting overcharged VAT
notes: A credit note reduces both the expense and the recoverable input VAT. Under VATCA s.59(2), a credit note for an input VAT deduction must be reported in the same period as the original invoice for it to reduce the same period's VAT return; otherwise it carries forward. The general rule (s.59) and standard rate exist in the KB. Review required because rules are ai_extracted.
